test_title: PYST 25 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper provides two consecutive discounts of 20% and 10% on an item. Calculate the single discount rate that is equivalent to these successive discounts.
solution:
**Given:**

First discount = 20%

Second discount = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Equivalent single discount = 100 - [(100 - d₁) × (100 - d₂) ÷ 100]

**Calculation:**

⇒ Equivalent single discount = 100 - [(100 - 20) × (100 - 10) ÷ 100]

⇒ Equivalent single discount = 100 - [80 × 90 ÷ 100]

⇒ Equivalent single discount = 100 - [7200 ÷ 100]

⇒ Equivalent single discount = 100 - 72

⇒ Equivalent single discount = 28%

**∴ The correct answer is 28%.**
